description: Bookmark addition form page. Accepts POST requests with 'name' and 'url' parameters. Returns HTTP 200 for GET, redirects to /list for POST.
notes: Form with two fields: 'name' (text input) and 'url' (URL input type). POST submission redirects to /list. Form uses Bootstrap styling. Accepts GET (returns 200) and POST (returns 302 redirect to /list) methods.
